_schema_notes.coverage: Authoritative schema for all DID formats — DD Form 1664 (pre-2014) and free-text (post-2014 MIL-STD-963C)
_schema_notes.did_format: Set to 'dd_form_1664' or 'free_text'. Determines which fields are expected to be populated.
_schema_notes.963c_compliant: True if the DID was prepared under MIL-STD-963C (2014 or later). False for older DIDs.
_schema_notes.reserved_fields: Fields marked RESERVED are present in one format but not the other. Always include them — set to empty string or empty array when not applicable.
_schema_notes.preparation_instructions: Official MIL-STD-963C name for what was previously called 'requirements'. Contains the numbered sections of the DID. All section numbers are normalized to strictly numeric dot-notation (1, 1.1, 1.1.1). Letter-based source numbering (2.a, 3.1.b) is converted to numeric equivalents (2.1, 3.1.2).
_schema_notes.asterisk: True if the requirement number is followed by * in the source document (conditional requirement).

title: Contractor's Safety Plan
summary: Establishes, documents, implements, and maintains safety requirements appropriate for shipyard work performed under 29 CFR 1915, the OSHA standards for shipyard employment.
use_relationship:
This DID will be used to establish, document, implement and maintain requirements that are appropriated for the work to be accomplished to the requirements of 29 CFR 1915, Occupational Safety and Health Standards for Shipyard Employment. (https://www.osha.gov).

This DID contains the format and content preparation instructions for the data product generated by the discrete task requirement as delineated in the contract.
distribution_statement: DISTRIBUTION STATEMENT A: Approved for public release; distribution is unlimited.

preparation_instructions.title: Format
preparation_instructions.content: The report shall be in the contractor's format.

preparation_instructions.title: Content
preparation_instructions.content: The report shall include the following information:

children.title: Method(s) of communicating potential hazards, prior to the start of any task, to contractor's employees
Hazards shall include emergency evacuation and muster policy, confined space, and energy control
Method(s) of communicating potential hazards, prior to the start of any task, to subcontractors and other potentially affected personnel
Hazards shall include emergency evacuation and muster policy, confined space, and energy control
Process for performing a Job Safety Analysis/Job Hazard Analysis (JSA/JHA)
Processes and equipment new to the worksite
Existing processes and equipment that have been involved in mishaps or near misses
Process for identification, communication, abatement, and prevention of unsafe conditions and work practices
Method(s) to account for employees and subcontractors working in isolated areas, e.g. confined spaces
Method(s) to ensure work areas and walkways are adequately illuminated
Method(s) to establish and maintain good housekeeping practices
Method(s) to ensure that medical services and first aid are readily accessible
Method(s) to provide adequate and readily accessible sanitation facilities
Process for notifying the Quarterdeck and initiating emergency response
